chunks: A group from Khurasan came to Abi al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام and asked him to absolve them from the khums. So he said: How far-fetched this is! You devote affection to us with your tongues, while you withhold from us a right that Allah has appointed for us and appointed us for, and that is the khums. We do not absolve any one of you from it.

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّل: Imam al-Rida عليه السلام, the Imam being addressed
key_terms.الْخُمُسُ: khums, the one-fifth due appointed by Allah
key_terms.حَقّاً: a right or due entitlement established by Allah
key_terms.خُرَاسَانَ: Khurasan, the region from which the group came
key_terms.فِي حِلٍّ: in a state of release or exemption from liability

ai.seo_question: Did Imam al-Rida عليه السلام permit his followers to be exempted from khums?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam al-Rida عليه السلام refused a request from a group of people to exempt them from khums. It emphasizes that khums is a divinely assigned right of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, and that mere verbal profession of محبت without fulfilling this right is not accepted.
